positions.title: Senior Software Architect
positions.description:
 Supported the decommissioning of a core system
 Evolved architecture for new system to replace decommissioned system
 Evolved architecture to update and maintain multiple interacting applications.
 Developed new application architecture.
 Developed new API Gateway architecture.
 Supported 25+ Software Developers, Software Quality Engineers and Product Managers.
 Assisted with the creation and review of agile stories, features, and epics.
 Participated in Architecture Practice to develop and evolve standards, recommendations, and best practices.
 Assisted with recruiting and interviewing potential new architects and developers.
 Provided technical expertise to software developers.
 Assisted with code reviews.
 Developed prototypes and examples (Python, Java, SQL)
 Web Applications, microservices, web services, database design, diagrams, technical documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: Architecture · AWS · Solution Architecture · Python · Java · Spring Boot · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Consultant Programmer/Analyst
positions.description: Primarily worked on a project called "Overture" which was a massive effort to rewrite their Marketing, Billing and Service Order systems. The project started out in Smalltalk and then switched to C++. The Requirements and Analysis efforts totally consumed the budget and, in the end, they split up the development team and refocused on updating and adding functionality to several smaller scope, high-value subsystems.

positions.title: Base Level DBA/Sys Admin
positions.description: Managed Sperry/Unisys mainframe systems, tape libraries, training, planning, software maintenance and updates, managed teams of 3-5 people. Earned a Medal of Accommodation for reorganizing workgroup during Desert Storm operations to better meet the needs of our mission.
